facts.text: The resort is a coastal resort a short drive from many scenic attractions and tourism hotspots of Pattaya.
facts.excerpt: A charming coastal resort in a peaceful sanctuary, just a short drive from many scenic attractions and tourism hotspots of Pattaya, Thailand

facts.text: The resort is a tropical retreat on the oceanfront.
facts.excerpt: Indulge Your Senses at This Lush Tropical Retreat on the Oceanfront

facts.text: The resort's address is in Na Jomtien Sub-District, Sattahip, Chon Buri.
facts.excerpt: 345, Moo 3, Na Jomtien Sub-District, Sattahip, Pattaya, Chon Buri 20250, Thailand

facts.text: Rooms are locally inspired, with options including beachfront suites and pool villas.
facts.excerpt: spacious, locally inspired rooms with a variety of options to choose from, including lifestyle beachfront suites and lavish pool villas

facts.text: Houses with multiple rooms are offered for larger families and groups.
facts.excerpt: For larger families and groups, two houses with multiple rooms provide the perfect balance of space and privacy.

facts.text: The Beachfront Pool Villa has an ocean view and direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: this 104-square-meter villa offers a blissful retreat with an ocean view and direct beach access

facts.text: The Beachfront Pool Villa has a private pool and a living room with a wet bar.
facts.excerpt: a living room with a wet bar and dining area, a bathroom that invites indulgence, and a 29-square-meter private pool

facts.text: The Beachfront Suite has ocean views, direct beach access and a living and dining area.
facts.excerpt: Ocean views and direct beach access add to the indulgence of this 95-square-meter suite with a living and dining area

facts.text: Pool Access rooms have direct access to the lagoon pool.
facts.excerpt: Take a dip in the pool whenever you choose with direct lagoon access from this 50-square-meter room

facts.text: Roof Garden rooms have a 4-meter-high sloped ceiling.
facts.excerpt: the extra sense of space that comes with a 4-meter-high sloped ceiling

facts.text: Garden View rooms are timber-floored.
facts.excerpt: Delight in the tropical garden view from this 50-square-meter timber-floored room

facts.text: Rooms include a complimentary minibar with snacks and drinks.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary minibar with snacks and drinks

facts.text: Rooms have a daybed on the balcony.
facts.excerpt: Daybed on balcony

facts.text: The Heritage House is two storeys, and its rooms have ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Situated within our two-storey Heritage House, this 110-square-meter room comes with a king bed, a lifestyle bathroom, ocean views.

facts.text: The 3 Bedroom Heritage House shared spaces include a lounge, dining facilities and an outdoor terrace with a hot tub.
facts.excerpt: including a lounge, dining facilities, a 15-meter-long pool and an outdoor terrace with a hot tub

facts.text: The 2 Bedroom Manor House Duplex has ocean views and a private pool.
facts.excerpt: a private lifestyle residence with ocean views accommodating up to 5 guests

facts.text: In the Manor House Duplex, the second floor is reached by an outdoor staircase.
facts.excerpt: Access to the second floor is via an outdoor staircase and separate door

facts.text: The resort has the Sanuk Sanuk Kids' Club.
facts.excerpt: Sanuk Sanuk Kids’ Club

facts.text: The resort has a spa.
facts.excerpt: Spa & Wellness

facts.text: Fish Club is a beachside restaurant and bar grilling seafood from local fishermen over coconut husks.
facts.excerpt: At our beachside restaurant and bar, enjoy the sea breeze and the enticing aroma of fresh seafood caught by local fishermen as it’s expertly grilled the traditional way over coconut husks.

facts.text: Ruen Thai is a teahouse crafted from teakwood with indoor and outdoor seating on two levels.
facts.excerpt: Traditionally crafted from teakwood, Ruen Thai offers indoor and outdoor seating across two levels

facts.text: La Cucina serves Italian food and is decorated with blue and white hand-painted tiles.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant’s blue and white hand-painted tiles capture the breezy tropical feel of coastal dining.

facts.text: Teak Lounge overlooks Raintree Court and a water lily pond.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the serene Raintree Court and water lily pond

facts.text: Guests can paint a miniature Khon mask of Rama, Hanuman or Tosakanth.
facts.excerpt: Create your own piece of Thai tradition, by painting a miniature mask of Rama, Hanuman or Tosakanth

facts.text: Picnics can be set up in the gardens at Raintree Court or Tonsai Court, or on the beachfront.
facts.excerpt: Choose your setting - lush gardens at Raintree Court or Tonsai Court, or Beachfront bliss

facts.text: Weddings can be held in the Garden Pavilion or on the beachfront.
facts.excerpt: Host the perfect celebration and express your individual style in our Garden Pavilion or on our beautiful beachfront.

facts.text: U-Tapao International Airport is 24.9 kilometers away.
facts.excerpt: U-Tapao International Airport (UTP)24.9 kilometers

facts.text: Suvarnabhumi Airport is 134 kilometers away.
facts.excerpt: Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK)134 kilometers

facts.text: Self-parking is complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary self-parking is available for guests at Andaz Pattaya Jomtien Beach.

facts.text: Pets are not permitted at the resort.
facts.excerpt: Pets are not permitted at the resort.

facts.text: The resort describes itself as a peaceful sanctuary.
facts.excerpt: A charming coastal resort in a peaceful sanctuary
